notes.title: Scheduled for an update to version 2.0 in early next year
notes.content:
I am excited to announce the upcoming 2.0 version update, which will bring significant changes.

[b]1. Expanded View[/b]

I have adjusted the game's zoom settings to provide a wider field of view. However, with the expanded view, there are areas in the map that may appear empty, so I am currently redesigning the map to improve this.

[b]2. Additional Story and Content[/b]

Based on your feedback expressing disappointment over the short length, I will be adding new stories and interesting content.

[b]3. Other Improvements[/b]

* Improved interactions with characters and traps
* Fixes for existing issues and bugs
* Optimization of gameplay flow
